scope: Six current Sokoban configurations; readiness for formal review is separate from signed admission.

gates.name: Frozen observation, action, physics and budget contract
gates.required: One final policy/scorer/source/assets manifest; original goal and validity rules; C+/C- tools and time budgets matched

gates.name: Continuous physical witnesses
gates.required: All six current configurations have complete high/low/trajectory mappings, independent substep checks, full trajectory and recorded video

gates.name: Push-only and physical integrity review
gates.required: Opposed contact, directional force/motion, support, actuator and non-hand link/phase review; meaningful positive and negative checks; runtime mutations denied

gates.name: Dynamic mapping evaluation
gates.required: Fixed-frame occupancy plus predeclared connectivity queries and crate-update latency; unknown/censored observations remain explicit

gates.name: OS isolation and complete expert execution
gates.required: Private filesystem/PID/network namespaces per robot, readonly public bundle, no privileged files, strict packets; full representative run

gates.name: Frozen repeatability cohort
gates.required: L1 seed 0 three full physics runs; L1 seeds 1 and 2; declared second physical host; all outcomes retained

gates.name: Communication comparison
gates.required: Six paired seed-0 configurations; matched physical skills/budget/tool permissions; differences and uncertainty reported; no success required in C-

gates.name: Unseen topology cohort
gates.required: Two predeclared layouts, retained symbolic screening and representative full execution after policy freeze; no tuning on test outcomes

gates.name: Human review and independent reproduction
gates.required: Authorized reviewer inspects applicable full videos and critical positive/negative clips; independent reproduction record with actual identity and outcome

gates.name: Formal admission
gates.required: All applicable gates complete and authorized admission record; never infer signature from automated checks
